source.snippet: Sysadmin: 'we tried to connect a Sophos Connect Client to a OpenVPN Server with tls-auth/tls-crypt enabled... Sophos Connect Client seems not to be able to connect to a server with this security feature enabled.' — enterprise VPN product incompatibility blocking a security hardening initiative.

problem_statement: Enterprise sysadmins using Sophos Connect VPN clients cannot enable standard OpenVPN tls-auth/tls-crypt security hardening because the client silently fails, forcing a choice between security and compatibility with no clear resolution path.
target_segment: IT security teams and sysadmins at SMB/enterprise organizations using Sophos firewall + OpenVPN infrastructure
notes: Business security context — Sophos is a paid enterprise product. The friction of incompatibility between paid security tools creates consulting and tooling opportunities (compatibility shims, migration guides, alternative config generators).
